intro.text: A canal in the Final Empire, with a towpath running alongside it.
The main canal between Luthadel and Haverfrex in the Final Empire, joining the western bank of the River Channerel.

items.text: Kelsier and Vin hurried along the canal's towpath toward Holstep and the Arguois caverns, hoping to reach a battle between the skaa rebels and the Holstep and Valtroux garrisons.
Ashweather Cett's army camped near the canal and used it to bring supplies from Haverfrex.
